digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store / outbound create gate
propositions: Jira DC's Lucene index is eventually consistent, so a JQL label search can miss an issue that was just created but not yet indexed.
On a crash during create, recover_pending's keyless branch searches, misses due to index lag, and unbinds the pending entry.
create_one's JQL dedup then misses for the same index-lag reason and creates a duplicate Jira issue for the same local ticket.
Fixing only recover_pending is insufficient because get_jira_key returns None for a keyless-pending entry, so the create gate still emits a create.
The fix must defer the create at the outbound_differ gate while a keyless-pending binding is within an index-lag grace window, keeping the pending record so there is something to defer against.
Unbinding must require corroboration (>=3 consecutive misses and entry older than the grace period) so genuinely-absent issues eventually re-create without permanent stranding.
